B08F6GPQQ7.title: Ring Floodlight Cam Wired Plus, Outdoor Home or Business Security with Motion-Activated 1080p HD Video and Floodlights, White

B0B5VLCL1N.title: Blink Wired Floodlight Camera, Smart security camera, 2600 lumens, HD live view, enhanced motion detection, built-in siren, Works with Alexa, 1 camera (White)
bullets: Help protect your home day or night with Blink Wired Floodlight Camera — a smart security camera with 2600 lumens of LED lighting, enhanced motion detection, and a built-in security siren.
See and speak from the Blink app — Experience 1080p HD live view, night view in color, and crisp two-way audio.

Includes one Blink Wired Floodlight Camera and one installation kit.
